about.en: XUSD is a US-dollar stablecoin issued by StraitsX, a Major Payment Institution licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore. Each XUSD is backed by reserve assets and redeemable 1:1 for US dollars. It is deployed on Ethereum at 0xC08e7E23C235073C6807C2EFE7021304cb7c2815, on BNB Chain at 0xF81aC2E1A0373ddE1BcE01E2Fe694a9b7E3bfcB9 and on Solana. Unrelated tokens also use the XUSD ticker.
